text:
Aisha: New plant on the 3rd floor window sill needs a name. Suggestions? It has one dramatic leaf and a look. :leafy_green:
Marco: Leafy McLeafFace. Naturally. :crown: (reaction :laughing: from Eli)
Eli: Please no McFace names. I vote 'Dram' short for Dramatic.
Sam: I like 'Dram'. Also who booked the meeting room with no AC? Suffering. :hot_face:
Aisha: 'Dram' is adorable. Bonus points if name comes with a one-liner.
Marco: One-liner: "Photosynthesis? More like photo-sass-ynthesis." :seedling: :joy:
Eli: One-liner: "Dram's favorite music: houseplants." (I will see myself out)
SnackBot: Free granola bars by the printer. Please take one, not four. :bar_chart:
Sam: (grabs one) Thanks SnackBot. Also adding a ballot: name + one-liner = prize (bragging rights).
Aisha: Vote by reacting: :one: for Leafy McLeafFace, :two: for Dram, :three: for Something Wiser (open nominations welcome).
Marco: (reacts :two:)
Eli: (reacts :two:)
Sam: (reacts :three:)
Aisha: Tally so far: Dram leads. If you nom, post the one-liner too.
Marco: Nom: 'Sir Photos-a-Lot' with one-liner: "Always focuses on the positives." :camera:
Eli: Nom: 'Mango' because it deserves a fruit name. One-liner: "Ripe for compliments."
Aisha: OK Dram is cute but Mango has style. This poll is pure chaos and I love it.
SnackBot: Reminder: kitchen restock at 2pm. Coffee levels may dip between 2-2:30. :coffee:
Sam: Important note: dramatic leaf is refusing to share sunlight with my desk plant. Please mediate.
Aisha: Mediation scheduled. Outcome: Dram gets a tiny scarf. :scarf:
Marco: Can we get a tiny chair for Dram too? Plant wants comfort.
Eli: Deadline: 4pm today for final votes. Loser buys snacks. :money_with_wings:
Aisha: Voting closed at 4pm tomorrow, but snacks are on me if Mango wins. Deal?
Sam: Deal. One-liners and snacks: the modern workplace economy. :doughnut:
